project_type: Vite 6 + React 18 + TypeScript + TanStack Router + Convex (backend) + Tailwind CSS + shadcn/ui
build_system: bun (npm not available). Vite for bundling.
test_framework: vitest with jsdom (tests won't run due to jsdom/bun incompatibility in sandbox)
test_command: bun run build (TypeScript build passing is verification; bun run test won't work in sandbox)
verification_instructions: 1. Run `bun run build` (tsc && vite build) and confirm it passes. 2. Run `bun run lint` and confirm no MORE than 76 problems (baseline).
setup_instructions: Already set up. bun is available. Run `bun run build` to verify baseline.
environment_constraints: npm not available - use bun. Tests (vitest) won't run due to jsdom/bun incompatibility. TypeScript compilation is the primary verification. Convex backend must NOT be modified.
contribution_requirements: Single commit: feat: answer-first home with status summary, watched stations, and nearest default (#43). Branch: feat/r3-answer-first-home from main.

key_patterns.colored_dots: AlertLevelBadge uses w-2 h-2 rounded-full with bg-normal, bg-alert, bg-warning, bg-danger, bg-muted-foreground/50 for no-data
key_patterns.staleness: isStale(updatedAt) from src/utils/timeUtils.ts - returns true if >45min old or undefined
key_patterns.subscriptions: getSubscribedStationIds() from src/services/notificationService.ts returns string[] of station IDs from localStorage
key_patterns.filter_context: FilterContext in src/lib/FilterContext.tsx stores advancedFilters globally with updateAdvancedFilters(partial) method
key_patterns.station_data: StationData interface in stations/index.tsx with id, station_name, current_levels (alert_level string '0'|'1'|'2'|'3'), station_status boolean, latitude, longitude
key_patterns.location_hook: useLocation() from src/hooks/useLocation.ts exports { coordinates, isLoading, error, requestLocation }
key_patterns.pull_to_refresh: usePullToRefresh and PullToRefreshIndicator also used in cameras route - do NOT delete the files, just remove from stations

directory_structure: src/routes/stations/index.tsx = main stations page. src/components/ = reusable components. src/lib/ = context providers. src/hooks/ = custom hooks. src/services/ = service layer. src/utils/ = utilities.
